mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_testcase_bundles (problem_id, bundle_sha256, testcase_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, NULL, #{testcaseVersion}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE problem_id = #{problemId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO problem_testcase_bundles (problem_id, bundle_sha256, testcase_version, updated_at) VALUES (#{problemId}, NULL, 1, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bundle_sha256 = NULL, testcase_version = testcase_version + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
